description: Plan polished, audience-focused presentations and slide content.

defaultPrompt: Create a clear 8-slide presentation outline for this topic and audience.
Turn these notes into a persuasive presentation with speaker notes.
Review my slide outline for flow, clarity, and missing evidence.
interface.longDescription: Turn a topic, goal, or rough notes into a coherent presentation plan with a strong narrative, slide-by-slide content, visual direction, speaker notes, and a final quality check. Adapt the depth and tone to the audience, distinguish a text outline from an exported slide file, and never imply a presentation file was created unless one was actually produced.

name: presentation-maker
